newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says MOF closely watching forex moves.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says MOF closely watching forex moves.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told reporters on Thursday that the ministry was closely watching current developments in the foreign exchange markets.
"We cannot comment on specific currency levels. We are closely watching current developments," he said.

Sakakibara also declined to comment on an article in the Nikkei Financial Daily newspaper on Thursday which quoted him as saying that the dollar's correction of last year's sharp slide against the yen was about to finish.
The paper also quoted him as saying that the ministry was not trying to push the yen down further.
Sakakibara said the market view on Japan's economy was too pessimistic and that he believed it was stronger than the market thought.
He also said that the pace of decline in Japan's current account surplus was slowing down and the ministry was conducting research to find the cause of the slowdown.
